description: A semicolon in a bookmark name gives no warning, but the Insert button becomes inactive.
expected_report: In Insert > Bookmark, typing forbidden characters / \ @ * ? " , # shows a warning; a semicolon shows no warning, yet Insert is disabled, and the warning text does not list the semicolon. Expected: the semicolon is treated like the others (warning shown and listed).
difficulty: Typing single characters, a greyed-out button, a small warning line; the user tries many characters in a row.
